title: Lake Tahoe's West Shore Best Shore Kayak Tour
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels

Booking subject to cancellation if minimum required guests (2 people) has not been met and if no other parties have booked that tour for the same day, we will still launch the tour if you are willing to pay the price equivalent of our minimum number of people.
All guests must carry a lifejacket
Guests 14yrs and younger are required to WEAR their lifejacket
Subject to favorable weather conditions. If canceled due to poor weather, you will be given the option of an alternative date
Please provide your contact number at time of booking so the tour operator can follow up with important information about your tour
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Explore the historic western shore of magnificent Lake Tahoe on this 2 1/2 hour guided tour.  Paddle out on crystal clear, snow-fed water while hearing colorful stories of the west shore's most prominent landmarks and important personalities.  This is the perfect tour for families and visitors looking to learn more about this treasured landscape on an easy paddle near Tahoe City.  
**Please note the cost of the tour is $75.00 per person with a 2 person minimum - if selecting the "double" option it will automatically fill spots for 4 people. If your party has only 2 people chose "single" kayak tour and if you prefer a tandem/2 seater kayak just call the shop after booking and we will adjust the boat type for you.**
